تبتغوا (form VIII)
# تَبْتَغُوا (tabtaḡū) /tab.ta.ɣuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# تُبْتَغَوْا (tubtaḡaw) /tub.ta.ɣaw/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
